findings.description: The pouring bowl contains only green olives (00:00.000), yet dark purple/black olives land in the jar from 00:00.500 onward, and by 00:01.750 about half the jar contents are dark olives. Dark olives come out of a bowl that showed only green ones.

Between 00:01.000 (about 3 olives in jar) and 00:01.750 (about 15 olives), the jar gains more olives than the small bowl visibly held or poured. The jar keeps filling at 00:02–00:03 while the bowl is still shown with olives in it.

A small clear glass bottle appears on the counter to the right of the steel bowl at 00:04.500. That spot is empty in 00:04.250 and in all earlier frames, which share roughly the same framing. Nobody places it there.

At 00:04.750 the steel bowl is full of green olives. After a single one-hand scoop it is nearly empty by 00:05.250, and brown nut/pit-like objects suddenly show in it. The handful shown is too small to explain how much the bowl lost.

At 00:04.5–00:05.0 the hand picks olives straight from the steel bowl and no glass container is visible. At 00:05.500 the hands suddenly hold a filled glass bowl. The container reappears already full, with no visible pickup.
At 00:05.5–00:06.250 the refilled pouring bowl holds green olives scooped from a green-olive bowl. By 00:06.750–00:07.500 it holds several dark purple/black olives, which it was never filled with.

After pouring one small bowl of mostly green olives (00:07.5–00:08.75), the jar at 00:09.000 is much fuller (about 2/3) and now mostly dark purple/grey olives. Both the number added and the color mix are inconsistent with what was poured.
Several olives in the jar are a flat, semi-translucent blue-grey, unlike real olives. They read as ghostly or partly rendered objects next to the solid green and purple olives.
